headline: Nifty Holds 25,200 Amid Fed Rate Concerns; Cyient Semiconductors and Auto Stocks Lead Gains

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Concerns over potential U.S. Federal Reserve rate hikes weighing on investor sentiment
Early trade pressure from IT firms dragging on the broader market indices
Weakness in the Indian Rupee which slid to 93.49 against the U.S. dollar
Mixed global cues from international markets including the NASDAQ and Nikkei
whatHappening: The Nifty 50 index is trading above the 25,200 level after a range-bound start
Cyient Semiconductors secured a $10 million strategic investment from GlobalFoundries
The Nifty Auto index surged by 3% in early morning trade
Maruti Suzuki and Bharat Electronics emerged as top gainers in the current session
summary: Indian indices are trading with marginal gains as the Nifty 50 stays above 25,200 despite concerns over US Fed rate hikes. Cyient Semiconductors is in focus following a $10 million investment, while the Auto sector is seeing strong buying interest. Maruti Suzuki and Bharat Electronics are among the top gainers as the market remains range-bound.
